investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Pinewave Networks (mobile operator); Platform: AWS eu-central-1 (zones eu-central-1a/eu-central-1b/eu-central-1c); network range 10.176.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster pinewa-prod-eucent (EKS); Caching tier: self-managed Redis (cache-redis-03, maxmemory 12gb, allkeys-lru) in front of the sim-provisioning PostgreSQL database sim-db-01; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
